name: Corporate Action Fees And Charges
definition: The definition of all the charges related to a corporate action event.

CorporateAction.name: Corporate Action
CorporateAction.definition: Corporate action for which fees and charges are specified.

SolicitationFee.name: Solicitation Fee
SolicitationFee.definition: Cash amount made available in a corporate event in order to encourage participation in the event or to vote with management's position. Payment is made to a third party who has solicited an entity to take part in the offer.|Also called consent fee.

EarlySolicitationFeeRate.name: Early Solicitation Fee Rate
EarlySolicitationFeeRate.definition: Cash rate made available, as an incentive, in addition to the solicitation fee, in order to encourage early participation in an offer.

Commission.name: Commission
Commission.definition: Commission associated with a corporate action.
